$description: Confetti design tokens, W3C DTCG format. One group per theme+mode; values are fully resolved (accessibility exceptions applied).

200.$description: confetti brand Red, lifted furthest — the palest step, and the ONLY one that reads AS TEXT on every dark surface including `card` (4.96:1). This is also the ceiling that fixes how light `card` can go: there is nothing paler to fall back on.

300.$description: confetti brand Red, lifted — reads on the darker surfaces but not on card (3.50:1). Only usable as the dark accent when `card` is close to black, which it no longer is.

600.$description: deepened Red — the danger family's dark step.

100.$description: pale tint — the subtle end of the pair in LIGHT mode, carrying green.700 (5.25:1)

400.$description: success AS TEXT on a dark surface — lifted enough to clear AA on card, the lightest dark surface (5.5:1)

600.$description: the rich green — success as a FILL, carrying a white label (5.34:1). Same in both modes; a fill does not need to move.

700.$description: success AS TEXT on a light surface (4.86:1 on the old cream; 5.0:1 on porcelain)

800.$description: deep tint — the subtle end of the pair in DARK mode, carrying chalk (10.37:1)

300.$description: brand, lifted enough to read AS TEXT on the forest dark surface

500.$description: Adventure brand green — reads as text on sand (4.8:1) and as button fill w/ white (6.6:1)

300.$description: page baseline

a12.$description: bark at 12% — subtle border on sand

600.$description: warm near-black — Adventure light-mode text and borders

700.$description: raised

a16.$description: sand at 16% — subtle border on forest

600.$description: deep magenta — brand AS TEXT on light

300.$description: page — light lavender

900.$description: neon light text / border — deep purple

600.$description: card

700.$description: panel

900.$description: neon dark page — deep purple-black

100.$description: neon dark text / border — light lavender

300.$description: muted text — 8.61:1 on page, 7.18:1 on card, the lightest surface

400.$description: muted text on the deep ground — 6.35:1 on 900

450.$description: hover fill for a dark control — a clear step above card (a half-step, since it sits between the card surface and the text steps); 12.4:1 with text

500.$description: card — dark charcoal with a tiny hint of indigo. The lightest surface, and so the one that sets the contrast floor: the palest brand red still reads at 7.32:1 on it

600.$description: panel chrome — between raised and card

700.$description: raised — the canvas one step above page, a grayer charcoal

900.$description: recessed mat below page; also the deep ground of code blocks and dark panels

glow.$description: the halo on hover — a saturated indigo, bright enough to read as light rather than shadow, close to a neon tube

glow-edge.$description: the bright edge that defines the halo — near full strength, like the lit rim of a neon tube

highlight.$description: a faint light along the top edge of a surface — the sheen that separates a raised card from the page

50.$description: raised — the canvas one step above page, at the midpoint between page and card

200.$description: panel chrome — one step below page

300.$description: hover fill for a light control — a clear step below panel; 14.5:1 with ink

400.$description: recessed mat below page — app frames, control tracks

600.$description: muted text — 5.47:1 on page, 5.86:1 on card, 4.85:1 on panel

900.$description: ink — 17.1:1 on page

a24.$description: default border, and the halo on a card's hover

400.$description: utility step — off the 4px grid (like 14), for body-large / small subheads

600.$description: utility step — off the 4px grid, sits between h5 (20) and h4 (24)

hero.$description: container-query driven headline, above the fixed ramp

300.$description: card container

soft.$description: diffuse ambient shadow on light surfaces — rests just above the page

lifted.$description: soft, deeper — hover and floating surfaces on light

soft-deep.$description: dark-surface counterpart of soft — black, since a light shadow does not read on dark

halo.$description: a card's hover on a light surface: a soft halo of ink. IDENTICAL geometry to halo-deep — the two must always be the same size and spread; only the colour differs, because a dark shadow is what reads on light and light is what reads on dark.

halo-deep.$description: a card's hover on a dark surface: a bright, saturated indigo glow with a lit edge. Same geometry as halo — keep them in step.

highlight.$description: the light top edge of a raised surface on dark

lighten-strong.$description: 22% brighter — the bump a theme needs when brightness is carrying the whole hover, with no lift to help. 1.1 reads on a pale fill and all but vanishes on a deep one, which is what left Adventure's pine buttons looking inert.

brightness-rest.$description: 1 — no lightness change, the pressed counterpart to a theme's hover brightness

button-hover-brightness.$description: hover lightness multiplier for buttons that change lightness instead of lifting

subtle.$description: outer bound of the hand-placed sticker tilt — components scale this by a per-instance multiplier in -1..1

none.$description: no tilt — cards stay square on hover

max.$description: outer bound of the hand-placed sticker angle

still.$description: no transform at all. Distinct from `rest`, an identity translate: an identity transform is still a transform change, which promotes the element to its own layer and can shift its text by a subpixel on hover. A theme that does not move things should use this.

lift.$description: how far an interactive surface rises on hover

ambient.$description: one loop of a continuous, non-reactive animation — a texture that drifts rather than a state that changes
constant speed, so a looping animation has no perceptible seam

button-lift.$description: the hover transform on filled buttons — a lift, or rest (no move), per theme

300.$description: one loop of a continuous ambient motion — slow enough to read as texture moving, not as a control reacting

linear.$description: the only correct curve for a seamless loop — any easing makes a continuous animation pulse at the seam

300.$description: high-contrast focus ring / emphasis edges

control-compact.$description: 40px — a compact control, for secondary affordances such as a dialog's close button

thumb.$description: 20px — leaves a 2px inset on each side of the track

sm.$description: 16px — inline with body and control labels

dialog-md.$description: the default dialog — a paragraph or two plus actions

display.$description: hero only — fluid, sits above h1

h6.$description: meets body size — weight and family carry the distinction

deep.$description: a deep ground that stays deep in BOTH modes — a dark panel on a light page. Wired to the theme's syntax surface, which is already that: an inset dark ground per theme. Split into its own brand-kit input if a theme ever needs the panel and the code block to differ.

backdrop.$description: recessed mat — collapses to the deepest forest (no darker neutral; demo default)

on-scrim.$description: text and controls placed directly on the scrim rather than on a panel — a lightbox caption, a close button. It cannot be text.primary (which follows the mode and would vanish in light) or text.inverse (which follows it the other way and vanishes in dark): the scrim is deep in BOTH modes, so its foreground is fixed like it is.

thin.$description: 1px — soft pill / chip outline (Badge, Tabs indicator)

flat.$description: no shadow — pressed, and the resting default

edge.$description: the resting edge of a raised surface. Flat by default; a theme that wants a sheen sets it (Confetti dark does)

button-lift.$description: buttons still do NOT move — button-lift (the transform) stays at rest. The shadow appears under a stationary button, which reads as it pressing outward rather than sliding, and gives the hover a second cue beyond the lightness bump.

float.$description: held at rest by dialogs, toasts and thumbs — the same shadow as a card's lift in this theme

fill-hover.$description: this theme's secondary responds through brightness, not a background change, so the fill stays put

subtle.$description: the tint end goes deep in dark, like the accent tints

fill.$description: solid danger red, carrying a white label at 6.27:1 — the same in both modes; a fill does not need to move

text.$description: danger AS TEXT — the palest red, and the same lift brand-as-text takes. It has to be the palest one: red.300 fails on Confetti's `card` (3.50:1) and on Adventure's #35492f and Neon's #2e1650 too, so no theme on this mode can afford the more saturated step.

primary.$description: pine green — reads as text on sand (4.7:1) and as button fill with white (6.5:1)

secondary-hover-brightness.$description: how a secondary button responds on hover — this theme keeps the same lightness response as its other filled buttons

border-width.$description: soft pill — 1px hairline, not the 2px sticker edge

border.$description: soft pill — subtle tint, not the ink sticker border

neutral.$description: paper fill — a badge that isn't a category

fill.$description: clear at rest — the outline carries the meaning

shadow.$description: resting edge; the hover shadow below replaces it

muted.$description: comments and punctuation — present but receding

padding-horizontal.$description: 4px — snug, so the chip does not disturb the line

padding-vertical.$description: 0 — vertical padding on an inline box shifts line height without growing the line

font-family.$description: the mono face — same one Badge and Tabs label with

focus-ring-color.$description: the page ring is ink in light mode, which disappears on this ground

secondary-fill.$description: an inverted secondary: light fill on the deep ground

danger-text.$description: the danger label at rest — the status red is below AA as text on this ground, so the label goes light and the outline carries the red

shadow.$description: the sticker lift, held at rest — a dialog is already raised

gap.$description: 16px between header, body, and footer

close-size.$description: the close button's square footprint — a compact 40px hit area instead of a full 48px control pill

close-inset.$description: how far the close button is pulled into the panel padding, so its glyph sits nearer the corner than the content column does

scrim-fill.$description: the dim itself — the one consumer of the axis-independent --color-scrim role, fixed across themes and modes

text.$description: set on the scrim so anything placed straight onto it inherits a legible colour. Content that brings its own surface (Modal's panel) overrides this with its own foreground.

viewport-padding.$description: 24px — keeps the content off the viewport edge on small screens

height.$description: 48px — the hit area, not the rail

fill-fill.$description: the travelled portion — brand, so progress reads at a glance

thumb-shadow.$description: the sticker lift, held at rest — the knob sits above the rail

gap.$description: 8px between the rail and an adjacent label or value

border-width.$description: the sticker edge — a switch is a control, so it carries the same outline as a button

thumb-fill.$description: ink knob on the paper track

thumb-fill-checked.$description: and the inverse on the brand track

icon-color.$description: the glyph sits ON the thumb, so it takes the track's fill

gap.$description: 8px between the switch and an adjacent label

track-radius.$description: matches the pill — the rail is a control, not a container, so it takes the same radius the indicator does (999px round in Confetti, 12px in Adventure, square in Neon)

gap.$description: 4px between tabs

hover-text.$description: an idle tab warms to full-strength text on hover, short of the lit pill

font-size.$description: 14px mono — the control label, sized for legibility

tab-padding-horizontal.$description: 20px — roomy, so the control reads at a comfortable tap size

border-width.$description: the 2px sticker edge — same as Card

shadow.$description: the hard offset — a toast sits above the page, and this is how this system says so

min-width.$description: matches the small dialog, so a toast and a confirmation read as the same family

media-fill.$description: what shows before an image loads, or when there is none

media-inset.$description: how far the tag and index sit from the media edges

fill-hover.$description: a clear step lighter than the resting fill

on-bold.$description: bold hues stay light in dark mode, so the deepest midnight reads on them

on-subtle.$description: subtle tints are deep in dark mode — needs the light foreground

fill.$description: solid danger red, carrying a white label at 6.27:1 — the same in both modes; a fill does not need to move

primary.$description: brand color — drives text.accent, primary action fill, ghost hover

surface.$description: deepest midnight — the code block ground

border.$description: soft pill — subtle tint, not the ink sticker border

neutral.$description: paper fill — a badge that isn't a category

shadow.$description: resting edge; the hover shadow below replaces it

muted.$description: comments and punctuation — present but receding

padding-vertical.$description: 0 — vertical padding on an inline box shifts line height without growing the line

font-family.$description: the mono face — same one Badge and Tabs label with

focus-ring-color.$description: the page ring is ink in light mode, which disappears on this ground

secondary-fill.$description: an inverted secondary: light fill on the deep ground

danger-text.$description: the danger label at rest — the status red is below AA as text on this ground, so the label goes light and the outline carries the red

shadow.$description: the sticker lift, held at rest — a dialog is already raised

gap.$description: 16px between header, body, and footer

linear.$description: the only correct curve for a seamless loop — any easing makes a continuous animation pulse at the seam

300.$description: hover fill for a light control — a clear step below panel; 14.5:1 with ink

400.$description: recessed mat below page — app frames, control tracks

600.$description: muted text — 5.47:1 on page, 5.86:1 on card, 4.85:1 on panel

900.$description: ink — 17.1:1 on page

a24.$description: default border, and the halo on a card's hover

400.$description: utility step — off the 4px grid (like 14), for body-large / small subheads

600.$description: utility step — off the 4px grid, sits between h5 (20) and h4 (24)

hero.$description: container-query driven headline, above the fixed ramp

300.$description: card container

soft.$description: diffuse ambient shadow on light surfaces — rests just above the page

lifted.$description: soft, deeper — hover and floating surfaces on light

soft-deep.$description: dark-surface counterpart of soft — black, since a light shadow does not read on dark

halo.$description: a card's hover on a light surface: a soft halo of ink. IDENTICAL geometry to halo-deep — the two must always be the same size and spread; only the colour differs, because a dark shadow is what reads on light and light is what reads on dark.

halo-deep.$description: a card's hover on a dark surface: a bright, saturated indigo glow with a lit edge. Same geometry as halo — keep them in step.

highlight.$description: the light top edge of a raised surface on dark

lighten-strong.$description: 22% brighter — the bump a theme needs when brightness is carrying the whole hover, with no lift to help. 1.1 reads on a pale fill and all but vanishes on a deep one, which is what left Adventure's pine buttons looking inert.

brightness-rest.$description: 1 — no lightness change, the pressed counterpart to a theme's hover brightness

button-hover-brightness.$description: hover lightness multiplier for buttons that change lightness instead of lifting

subtle.$description: outer bound of the hand-placed sticker tilt — components scale this by a per-instance multiplier in -1..1

none.$description: no tilt — cards stay square on hover

max.$description: outer bound of the hand-placed sticker angle

still.$description: no transform at all. Distinct from `rest`, an identity translate: an identity transform is still a transform change, which promotes the element to its own layer and can shift its text by a subpixel on hover. A theme that does not move things should use this.

lift.$description: how far an interactive surface rises on hover

ambient.$description: one loop of a continuous, non-reactive animation — a texture that drifts rather than a state that changes
constant speed, so a looping animation has no perceptible seam

button-lift.$description: the hover transform on filled buttons — a lift, or rest (no move), per theme

300.$description: one loop of a continuous ambient motion — slow enough to read as texture moving, not as a control reacting

linear.$description: the only correct curve for a seamless loop — any easing makes a continuous animation pulse at the seam

300.$description: high-contrast focus ring / emphasis edges

control-compact.$description: 40px — a compact control, for secondary affordances such as a dialog's close button

thumb.$description: 20px — leaves a 2px inset on each side of the track

sm.$description: 16px — inline with body and control labels

dialog-md.$description: the default dialog — a paragraph or two plus actions

display.$description: hero only — fluid, sits above h1

h6.$description: meets body size — weight and family carry the distinction

deep.$description: a deep ground that stays deep in BOTH modes — a dark panel on a light page. Wired to the theme's syntax surface, which is already that: an inset dark ground per theme. Split into its own brand-kit input if a theme ever needs the panel and the code block to differ.

backdrop.$description: recessed mat — soft lavender-gray below the haze surfaces (demo default)

on-scrim.$description: text and controls placed directly on the scrim rather than on a panel — a lightbox caption, a close button. It cannot be text.primary (which follows the mode and would vanish in light) or text.inverse (which follows it the other way and vanishes in dark): the scrim is deep in BOTH modes, so its foreground is fixed like it is.

thin.$description: 1px — soft pill / chip outline (Badge, Tabs indicator)

flat.$description: no shadow — pressed, and the resting default

edge.$description: the resting edge of a raised surface. Flat by default; a theme that wants a sheen sets it (Confetti dark does)

float.$description: held at rest by dialogs, toasts and thumbs — the same shadow as a card's lift in this theme

fill-hover.$description: this theme's secondary responds through brightness, not a background change, so the fill stays put

subtle.$description: the tint end of the pair — Badge subtle, Toast

fill.$description: solid danger red, carrying a white label at 6.27:1 — the same in both modes; a fill does not need to move

text.$description: danger AS TEXT — 4.97:1 on the page, 6.27:1 on card

primary.$description: bright magenta — fill (with black label, 6:1) and text.accent on dark

on-primary.$description: black label on the neon fill — 80s style, and the only thing that passes on bright magenta

secondary-hover-brightness.$description: how a secondary button responds on hover — this theme keeps the same lightness response as its other filled buttons

border-width.$description: soft pill — 1px hairline, not the 2px sticker edge

border.$description: soft pill — subtle tint, not the ink sticker border

neutral.$description: paper fill — a badge that isn't a category

fill.$description: clear at rest — the outline carries the meaning

shadow.$description: resting edge; the hover shadow below replaces it

muted.$description: comments and punctuation — present but receding

padding-horizontal.$description: 4px — snug, so the chip does not disturb the line

padding-vertical.$description: 0 — vertical padding on an inline box shifts line height without growing the line

font-family.$description: the mono face — same one Badge and Tabs label with

focus-ring-color.$description: the page ring is ink in light mode, which disappears on this ground

secondary-fill.$description: an inverted secondary: light fill on the deep ground

danger-text.$description: the danger label at rest — the status red is below AA as text on this ground, so the label goes light and the outline carries the red

shadow.$description: the sticker lift, held at rest — a dialog is already raised

gap.$description: 16px between header, body, and footer

close-size.$description: the close button's square footprint — a compact 40px hit area instead of a full 48px control pill

close-inset.$description: how far the close button is pulled into the panel padding, so its glyph sits nearer the corner than the content column does

scrim-fill.$description: the dim itself — the one consumer of the axis-independent --color-scrim role, fixed across themes and modes

text.$description: set on the scrim so anything placed straight onto it inherits a legible colour. Content that brings its own surface (Modal's panel) overrides this with its own foreground.

viewport-padding.$description: 24px — keeps the content off the viewport edge on small screens

height.$description: 48px — the hit area, not the rail

fill-fill.$description: the travelled portion — brand, so progress reads at a glance

thumb-shadow.$description: the sticker lift, held at rest — the knob sits above the rail

gap.$description: 8px between the rail and an adjacent label or value

border-width.$description: the sticker edge — a switch is a control, so it carries the same outline as a button

thumb-fill.$description: ink knob on the paper track

thumb-fill-checked.$description: and the inverse on the brand track

icon-color.$description: the glyph sits ON the thumb, so it takes the track's fill

gap.$description: 8px between the switch and an adjacent label

track-radius.$description: matches the pill — the rail is a control, not a container, so it takes the same radius the indicator does (999px round in Confetti, 12px in Adventure, square in Neon)

gap.$description: 4px between tabs

hover-text.$description: an idle tab warms to full-strength text on hover, short of the lit pill

font-size.$description: 14px mono — the control label, sized for legibility

tab-padding-horizontal.$description: 20px — roomy, so the control reads at a comfortable tap size

border-width.$description: the 2px sticker edge — same as Card

shadow.$description: the hard offset — a toast sits above the page, and this is how this system says so

min-width.$description: matches the small dialog, so a toast and a confirmation read as the same family

media-fill.$description: what shows before an image loads, or when there is none

media-inset.$description: how far the tag and index sit from the media edges
